Morning early crew,
The shift leads recorded a reminder about lighting levels after dinner

Hello team,

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk workflow steady and clear when you answer traveler updates. Check the care plan notes before you confirm arrangements, and make sure crate checks, feeding notes, and comfort requests are entered in full. For lost crate follow-up, <<FACT F118>>. If a traveler asks for help with a pet handoff, keep the language simple and reassuring, and route anything unusual to the senior coordinator without delay.

When you review a file, look for species needs, temperament notes, and any item that may affect the animal's comfort. If the plan changes at the gate, update the record before you move on to the next case. Use direct wording, avoid assumptions, and keep every handoff aligned with Aurelia Skyways service standards. If a traveler has already been given an update, do not repeat it unless the record needs correction or the traveler returns with a new concern.

Please stay alert for small issues that can become larger ones, especially where lighting, noise, or crate placement may affect an animal. Keep the desk calm, accurate, and dependable, and flag anything that may require extra attention from the shift lead. Thank you for keeping companion travel steady for every traveler and pet.
